notes.en:
Initial release of the Orchestrator kit.
Turns Settings into a control panel for AI agent teams: route provider, model and reasoning effort for each of the 20 Craft dev-flow roles.
Fail-closed validation against the live provider catalog, atomic locked writes and per-role inherit defaults.
Ships the Orchestrator preset persona, 20 craft role cards and the dev-flow skill.
notes.pt-BR:
Primeira versão do Orchestrator kit.
Transforma as configurações em um painel de controle para times de agentes de IA: roteie provider, model e reasoning effort para cada um dos 20 papéis dev-flow Craft.
Validação fail-closed contra o catálogo de providers ao vivo, escritas atômicas com lock e padrões de herança por papel.
Inclui a persona de preset Orchestrator, 20 cartões de papéis craft e a skill dev-flow.
notes.zh:
Orchestrator 套件首个版本。
将设置变为 AI 智能体团队的控制面板：为 20 角色 Craft dev-flow 流水线的每个角色配置 provider、model 与 reasoning effort 路由。
基于实时 provider 目录进行 fail-closed 校验，写入原子化并带锁，支持按角色继承默认值。
随附 Orchestrator 预设 persona、20 张 craft 角色卡与 dev-flow skill。
